features.name: Board / List / Card Workflow
steps: Create a new board, add three lists named "Backlog", "In Progress", and "Done", create a card named "Prepare release notes" in "Backlog", and move it to "In Progress".
features.expected: Board must contain the three specified lists; the card must be created in "Backlog" and moved to "In Progress" with correct state.

features.name: Board / List / Card Workflow
steps: Set up a simple Kanban workflow with "To Do", "Doing", and "Done", create three cards in "To Do", and move one card through the workflow until it reaches "Done".
features.expected: Kanban workflow must be set up with three lists and three cards; a card must move through the workflow to "Done" successfully.

features.name: Board / List / Card Workflow
steps: Create a card in a specified list, add a description, move the card to another list, then confirm that the description remains unchanged after the move.
features.expected: Card description must remain unchanged after moving the card between lists.

features.name: Board / List / Card Workflow
steps: Archive a completed card, locate it from the board's archived items, restore it, and return it to the specified list.
features.expected: Archived card must be locatable in archived items, restorable, and returned to the specified list.

features.name: Card Task Management
steps: Create a task card, add a colored priority label, set a due date, add a three-item checklist, and complete one checklist item.
features.expected: Priority label, due date, and checklist must apply correctly; completing one item updates checklist progress.

features.name: Card Task Management
steps: Configure a card with a start date and due date, add a checklist, complete all checklist items, and mark the card as complete.
features.expected: Start/due dates and checklist must save; completing all items and marking complete updates card state correctly.

features.name: Card Task Management
steps: Create a new label with a specified name and color, apply it to a card, then filter the board so that only cards with that label are visible.
features.expected: Label must be created with the specified name and color; applying it and filtering must show only matching cards.

features.name: Card Task Management
steps: Attach a URL to a card, add display text for the attachment, close the card, reopen it, and verify that the attachment is still present.
features.expected: Attachment URL and display text must persist after closing and reopening the card.

features.name: Card Task Management
steps: Create a custom field for priority, assign a value to a card, and use the board interface to identify cards matching that priority value.
features.expected: Custom field value must save; the board interface must identify cards matching that priority value.

features.name: Card Task Management
steps: Add a checklist with multiple items, complete selected items, verify the progress percentage, then hide completed checklist items.
features.expected: Checklist progress percentage must be accurate; hiding completed items must not affect completion state.

features.name: Rules
steps: Create a rule that automatically moves a card to the "Done" list when the card is marked complete, then create a test card and verify that the rule runs.
features.expected: Rule must trigger when the card is marked complete and move it to "Done"; test card verifies the automation runs.

features.name: Rules
steps: Create a rule that adds an "Urgent" label and moves a card to the top of "In Progress" whenever the card enters a specified list.
features.expected: Rule must add the "Urgent" label and move the card to the top of "In Progress" when it enters the specified list.

features.name: Rules
steps: Create a rule that automatically adds a checklist named "Review" when a card receives a specified label.
features.expected: Rule must add the "Review" checklist automatically when the card receives the specified label.

features.name: Rules
steps: Create a rule that moves a card to "Ready for Review" when all items in a specified checklist are completed.
features.expected: Rule must move the card to "Ready for Review" when all checklist items are completed.

features.name: Rules
steps: Create a rule that detects cards whose title starts with "[Bug]", adds a bug label, and moves those cards into the "Triage" list.
features.expected: Rule must detect "[Bug]" titles, add the bug label, and move those cards to "Triage".

features.name: Rules
steps: Create a rule that reacts when a due date is added to a card and automatically adds a specified label and checklist.
features.expected: Rule must react to an added due date by adding the specified label and checklist.

features.name: Rules
steps: Create a multi-action rule that, when a card is added to "Incoming", assigns a label, creates a checklist, sets a due date, and moves the card to the top of "To Do".
features.expected: Multi-action rule must assign label, create checklist, set due date, and move the card to the top of "To Do" in one trigger.

features.name: Rules
steps: Create a rule that renames a card by preserving its existing card name and appending a specified status suffix using Trello's automation variables.
features.expected: Rule must rename the card by preserving the original name and appending the status suffix via automation variables.

features.name: Rules
steps: Create an automation rule, save it, disable it, verify that it no longer runs, re-enable it, and confirm that the same trigger works again.
features.expected: Disabling the rule stops it from running; re-enabling restores the same trigger behavior.

features.name: Rules
steps: Create a rule, trigger it with a test card, then inspect the automation activity or log to determine whether the automation executed successfully.
features.expected: Automation activity or log must correctly show whether the rule executed successfully.

features.name: Scheduled Automation
steps: Create a scheduled automation that creates a new recurring card in a specified list every day at the configured schedule.
features.expected: Scheduled automation must create the recurring card in the specified list on schedule.

features.name: Scheduled Automation
steps: Create a weekly automation that moves all cards from "Next Week" into "To Do" and then sorts "To Do" by due date.
features.expected: Weekly automation must move all cards from "Next Week" to "To Do" and sort "To Do" by due date.

features.name: Scheduled Automation
steps: Create a monthly automation that creates a new planning list with a specified name on the first day of every month.
features.expected: Monthly automation must create the planning list with the specified name on the first day of each month.

features.name: Scheduled Automation
steps: Create a recurring cleanup automation that archives completed cards from a specified list on a weekly schedule.
features.expected: Recurring cleanup must archive completed cards from the specified list weekly.

features.name: Scheduled Automation
steps: Create a scheduled automation that moves cards older than a specified number of days from one list into an archive or cleanup list.
features.expected: Scheduled automation must move cards older than the specified days into the archive/cleanup list.

features.name: Due Date Automation
steps: Create a due-date automation that moves a card into "Overdue" and adds a red label at the moment the card becomes due.
features.expected: Due-date automation must move the card to "Overdue" and add the red label at the due moment.

features.name: Due Date Automation
steps: Create an automation that adds an "Urgent" label and moves the card to "Due Soon" two days before the card's due date.
features.expected: Automation must add the "Urgent" label and move the card to "Due Soon" two days before the due date.

features.name: Due Date Automation
steps: Create an automation that performs a specified workflow on the Monday before a card becomes due and verify that the relative-date trigger is configured correctly.
features.expected: Relative-date trigger must fire on the Monday before the due date and perform the specified workflow.

features.name: Due Date Automation
steps: Build a recurring-task workflow that, when a card becomes due, moves its due date to the same day next week and resets its checklist for the next cycle.
features.expected: Recurring workflow must move the due date to the same day next week and reset the checklist for the next cycle.

features.name: Card Button
steps: Create a card button named "Start Work" that moves the current card to "In Progress", adds a status label, and sets an appropriate due date.
features.expected: Card button must move the card to "In Progress", add the status label, and set an appropriate due date.

features.name: Card Button
steps: Create a card button named "Complete Task" that marks the card complete, moves it to "Done", and removes its due date.
features.expected: Card button must mark the card complete, move it to "Done", and remove the due date.

features.name: Board Button
steps: Create a board button that performs a weekly cleanup by archiving completed cards and moving outstanding cards into a specified active list.
features.expected: Board button must archive completed cards and move outstanding cards into the specified active list.

features.name: Board Button
steps: Create a board button that moves a selected set of cards into another list and then sorts that destination list by due date.
features.expected: Board button must move the selected cards into another list and sort the destination list by due date.

features.name: Cascade
steps: Create a rule that finds the first Trello card linked in the triggering card's attachments and applies a specified change to the linked card.
features.expected: Rule must find the first linked card in attachments and apply the specified change to it.

features.name: Cascade
steps: Create an automation that converts checklist items into linked cards while preserving links between the original card and the generated cards.
features.expected: Automation must convert checklist items into linked cards while preserving links to the original card.

features.name: Cascade
steps: Create an automation that iterates through cards linked from a checklist or attachment and applies the same follow-up action to each linked card.
features.expected: Automation must iterate linked cards and apply the same follow-up action to each.
